adapter.note: No UG_SKETCH_PROJECT_CURVE exists. UG_CURVE_PROJECT (#5977) is in modeling context. NX_DRAW_SHAPE_PROJECT_CURVE (#723) is in draw_shape. For sketch, the project curve function may be invoked differently — verify locally.
Equal Length is the primary equal constraint. UG_SKETCH_EQUAL_RADIUS_CONSTRAINT (#679) covers radius equality separately.
No standalone UG_SKETCH_REMOVE_CONSTRAINT exists. Use UG_SKETCH_CONSTRAINT_NAVIGATOR (#895, 'Sketch Constraints Browser') to manage and remove constraints.
UG_NXPOS_SHOW_DOF (#8442) exists but is for assembly constraints, not sketch. Sketch DOF display may need a different adapter — verify locally.
Covered by UG_SKETCH_CONSTRAINT_NAVIGATOR (#895, 'Sketch Constraints Browser') which shows all constraints/relations. No standalone show-relations button exists.
Covered by UG_SKETCH_CONSTRAINT_NAVIGATOR (#895, 'Sketch Constraints Browser') which includes 'External Reference' in its synonyms. No standalone external-references button exists.
UG_SKETCH_CHECKING (#1482, 'Sketch Checking') runs validation to find issues (tiny gaps, errors). This is the closest match for sketch issues/diagnostics.
